# phase-089 — Give caught failures a type so `catch error of <Type>` can match

## You must change `src/`

This phase declares `must_touch: [src/]`. The gate fails the phase unless at
least one changed file falls under it. Writing tests, documentation or a report
is not enough — if you finish without touching that area, the phase fails on
exactly that check.


## Evidence — verified finding

```
Phase-048 proved the negative: Redblue's runtime errors carry no type. `src/error.rs:78` defines `Error::{Lexer,Parser,Analyzer,Runtime,Io}` as compile-time kinds, and a caught failure binds the untyped text `error` (src/interpreter.rs:1772-1774, src/bytecode/vm.rs:3326) — so there is nothing for `of <Type>` to match against. 048 corrected SPEC.md/GRAMMAR.md to the untyped form and named this as the follow-up: inventing a tagged error value touches `Value`, both VMs, `Error`, the `.rbc` format and every runtime failure site. That is this phase, whole.
```

**Re-verify this before you change anything.** If the finding no longer
reproduces on `main`, stop and write that to `FINDINGS.md` — a stale phase must
never be "fixed" by inventing a change.

## Goal

Introduce a typed error value (a new `Value` variant or a tagged record shape, whichever disturbs the format least) carrying kind + message + span, raise it at every runtime failure site on both engines, and implement `catch error of <Type>` matching with the untyped `catch error` form unchanged. The `.rbc` format version bumps if and only if the encoding changes; the differential suite must stay green throughout.

## Method

1. Read `AGENTS.md` in full. Obey every hard rule; they are not negotiable.
2. Reproduce the finding. Record the exact command and the exact wrong output.
3. Write the failing test FIRST. Watch it fail. Do not touch production code
   until you have a red test that fails for the right reason.
4. Make the smallest change that turns it green.
5. Run the four gates yourself before claiming anything:

   ```bash
   cargo fmt --all -- --check
   cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings
   cargo test --all-targets
   ./rbops/verify.sh phase-089
   ```

6. Write `REPORT.md` in the exact shape required by `AGENTS.md` section 4.

## Definition of done

- [ ] `catch error of Io` catches a failed `files.read` and ignores a `1 + "x"` type error in the same body (both directions pinned — a matcher that catches everything proves nothing)
- [ ] the untyped `catch error` form behaves byte-identically to before (the existing `catch_binding_test.rs` suite passes unmodified — no silent migration)
- [ ] both engines raise the same typed value for the same failure (one differential test per failure kind across tree-walker and bytecode VM, kinds diffed not eyeballed)
- [ ] `rb dis` on a program containing a typed catch shows no new operand shape unless the format version bumped, in which case `docs/BYTECODE.md` documents it in the same commit
- [ ] SPEC.md documents the type names a program can match (closed list, asserted by a test that matches each one and refuses an invented one by name)
- [ ] edge_* tests cover matching a supertype/all-errors form if one exists, a `catch of` with no matching arm falling through to the untyped arm, error values escaping the `catch` body as first-class values (inspectable, printable), and a 200-deep error chain (no stack growth per frame)
